lean_reconstruction.detail: 18 theorems, Lean 4.33.1, exit code 0. T8 factor independence for all six factors, T10 blocker retention including that composition never silently clears a blocker, T11 survival as a biconditional over support families, and T20 noninterference for arbitrary execution-only transformations and arbitrary states.

vacuity_and_honesty_checks.detail: sorryAx appears ZERO times, so nothing is admitted unproven -- that is the check that matters in Lean, because a file full of `sorry` compiles happily. Axiom dependencies are reported per theorem: t8 and t20 depend on NO axioms at all; t10 uses propext; t11 uses propext and Quot.sound. All are standard and none were introduced by me. Three guard theorems additionally show the encodings are not constant -- admits, blocker composition and survival each produce both true and false, so the results are not artifacts of a predicate that can only say yes.

relation_to_the_python_jobs.detail: These obligations were also enumerated in EXEC-CM-01, EXEC-P6-01 and EXEC-P15-01 in Python. Lean is a different engine with a different encoding and a kernel that checks the proof term, so agreement is not one implementation agreeing with itself. It is still the same author.

what_this_does_not_establish: EXEC-PA-01 is NOT discharged. Independent review is the part that is missing, and it is missing structurally: a reviewer inside this programme is not independent, and neither is its author.
Only the decidable fragment is reconstructed. T0, T4, T6 and T7 involve induction over operational traces and are not covered here.
